entries.source:
Weapons that are not the same Weapon Type that you are
currently wearing are [[x1.20]] more ##common.
<color=grey>[Weapon Types are //Melee, //Ranged and Magic.]</color>
entries.translation:
与你当前使用的武器类型不同的武器
出现频率乘以 [[x1.20]]，更为##常见。
<color=grey>[武器类型分为//近战、//远程和魔法。]</color>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55795

entries.source: Gain a [[50%]] chance that Food Rewards match your highest Attribute.
entries.translation: 食物奖励有 [[50%]] 几率对应你的最高属性。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55796

entries.source: Floor 3 has an additional Armory, but it only contains 2 Weapons.
entries.translation: 第 3 层额外出现一间军械库，但其中只有 2 把武器。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55797

entries.source: Gain a [[10%]] Discount in all Shops.
entries.translation: 所有商店提供 [[10%]] 折扣。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55798

entries.source:
With each consecutive Item sold at a Pawn Shop, following Items sell for
[[+1]] Gold<sprite name="Gold"> up to a maximum of [[+10]].
entries.translation:
在当铺连续出售物品时，后续物品的售价每件增加
[[+1]] 金币<sprite name="Gold">，最高增加 [[+10]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55799

entries.source: Staying over night at the Tavern costs [[5]] Gold<sprite name="Gold"> instead of 10.
entries.translation: 在酒馆过夜只需 [[5]] 金币<sprite name="Gold">，而非 10。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55800

entries.source: Colors of Traits offered to you are more likely to match the colors of Traits you already have.
entries.translation: 提供的特质更有可能与你已有特质的颜色相同。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55801

entries.source: Gain [[+1]] Suppression<sprite name="Suppression"> in the Floor 1, 2 and 3 Boss Fight.
entries.translation: 在第 1、2、3 层首领战中获得 [[+1]] 压制<sprite name="Suppression">。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55802

entries.source: Gain [[+1]] Suppression<Suppression> in the Floor 10 Boss Fight.
entries.translation: 在第 10 层首领战中获得 [[+1]] 压制<Suppression>。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55803

entries.source: Locked Cellars never contain locked Treasure Chests.
entries.translation: 上锁的地窖里不会出现上锁的宝箱。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55804

entries.source:
Weapons of the same Weapon Class that you started with, 
are [[x1.20]] more //common.
<color=grey>[E.g.: Sword, Bow, Gun, Wand, ...]</color>
entries.translation:
与你初始武器同类的武器， 
出现频率乘以 [[x1.20]]，更为//常见。
<color=grey>[例如：剑、弓、枪、魔杖……]</color>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55805

entries.source:
The Black Market always has the Kuo-Tao selling Fish.
You also gain a [[50%]] Discount at that Shop.
entries.translation:
黑市必定有寇涛鱼人出售鱼类。
该商店还会提供 [[50%]] 折扣。

entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55877

entries.translation:
在 1 级时
获得 [[+1]] 次特质重掷。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55878

entries.source: Treasure Chests gain [[+20%]] chance to contain an additional Item.
entries.translation: 宝箱包含额外物品的几率提高 [[+20%]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55879

entries.source: On Floor 1, you are guaranteed a Door that leads to a ##Charm Reward as Boss Reward.
entries.translation: 第 1 层必定有一道门，其首领奖励为##护符。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55880

entries.source:
Upon entering Floor 2, 
gain [[+1]] point of 
a random Alignment.
<g>(Alignments are Good<Good>, Evil<Evil>, Lawful<Lawful> and Chaotic<Chaos>.</g>
entries.translation:
进入第 2 层时， 
随机一种阵营倾向
提高 [[+1]] 点。
<g>（阵营倾向包括善良<Good>、邪恶<Evil>、守序<Lawful>与混乱<Chaos>。</g>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55881

entries.source: Gold<Gold> Prices in Shops under 10 are reduced to 5.
entries.translation: 商店中低于 10 金币<Gold>的价格降至 5。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55882

entries.source:
Blacksmiths sell
Repair Powder for 5 Gold<sprite name="Gold">.
entries.translation:
铁匠出售修理粉，
售价为 5 金币<sprite name="Gold">。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55883

entries.source: On Floor 1, you are guaranteed a Door that leads to a Weapon Reward as Boss Reward.
entries.translation: 第 1 层必定有一道门，其首领奖励为武器。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55884
原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55885

entries.source: Enchanted Enemy Packs have [[x0.90]] Health<Heart> and Armor<Armor>.
entries.translation: 附魔敌人群的生命<Heart>与护甲<Armor>为 [[x0.90]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55886

entries.source: Once per Run, when you enter a Floor beyond Floor 5 without any Keys<Key>, gain [[2]] Keys<Key>.
entries.translation: 每局一次，进入第 5 层之后的楼层时，若没有钥匙<Key>，则获得 [[2]] 把钥匙<Key>。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55887

entries.source:
Defeating a Boss without taking Damage grants
you [[+1]] Magic Find<sprite name="Magic_Find"> just for that Reward Selection.
entries.translation:
无伤击败首领后，
仅在本次奖励选择中获得 [[+1]] 魔法发现率<sprite name="Magic_Find">。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55888

entries.source: Reduces Alignment Requirement to enter Final Floors by [[1]].
entries.translation: 进入最终楼层所需的阵营倾向降低 [[1]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55889

entries.translation: 秘密房间会被高亮显示。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55890

entries.source:
You encounter more Mimics but you get no hint for their upcoming appearance anymore.
<color=grey>[Info: Mimics grant twice the Rewards of Treasure Chests, so more Mimics equals more Rewards.]</color>
entries.translation:
你会遇到更多宝箱怪，但不再提前收到它们出现的提示。
<color=grey>[提示：宝箱怪提供的奖励是宝箱的两倍，因此宝箱怪越多，奖励就越多。]</color>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55891

entries.translation: 暮光树枝出现频率乘以 [[x2.00]]，更为//常见。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55892

entries.source: Boss Rewards that guarantee an Item of a certain Rarity now guarantee that Rarity or a higher Rarity for all Items offered.
entries.translation: 原本保证一件特定稀有度物品的首领奖励，现在会保证所有选项的稀有度不低于该稀有度。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55893
原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55894

entries.source: Gain [[+30%]] chance for enchanting to result in a Legendary Enchantment Modifier.
entries.translation: 附魔结果为传奇附魔词缀的几率提高 [[+30%]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55895

entries.source: On Entering Floor 2, 4, 6 and 8 gain [[+1]] of your lowest Attribute.
entries.translation: 进入第 2、4、6、8 层时，最低属性提高 [[+1]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55896

entries.source: Trait Selections always contain a Trait of the color that matches your lowest Attribute.
entries.translation: 每次特质选择都会包含一个颜色与你最低属性对应的特质。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55897

entries.source:
The Black Market always has Smuggler selling Companions<Companion>.
You also gain a [[50%]] Discount at that Shop.
entries.translation:
黑市必定有走私者出售同伴<Companion>。
该商店还会提供 [[50%]] 折扣。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55898

entries.source: Shops gain a [[25%]] to have 1 additional offer.
entries.translation: 商店有 [[25%]] 几率增加 1 个商品。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55899

entries.source:
Blood Chests and
Blood Altars are 
[[x1.30]] more //common.
entries.translation:
血宝箱与
鲜血祭坛
出现频率乘以 [[x1.30]]，更为//常见。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55900

entries.source:
All Blacksmiths now charge
[[5]] Souls<sprite name="Soul"> instead of 
20 Gold<sprite name="Gold"> per Upgrade Level.
entries.translation:
所有铁匠每次升级
改为收取 [[5]] 灵魂<sprite name="Soul">，而非
20 金币<sprite name="Gold">。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55901

entries.source: While on full Stamina<Stamina>, your Hitbox is [[smaller]].
entries.translation: 体力<Stamina>全满时，你的判定范围[[更小]]。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Meta_Perk_Tree.System.MetaPerk / resources.assets / 55902
